svg.title: Normal bundles, excluded work and traces have distinct populations
svg.desc: Excluded warmup and priming are retained separately from two hundred forty normal measured bundles and twelve proposed traced bundles. Each bundle has sixteen operations, but its average does not supply sixteen independent latency samples. Every useful result requires correctness and safe retirement.

g.text: Keep workload populations distinct when reporting performance
Raw bundle time: one completed sample
Divide by 16 only for amortized time
Do not infer per-operation p99 from averages
Correctness, exact bytes, identity and safe retirement gate every useful result.
Warmup count does not prove stable cache, clocks, thermals or interference.
A traced median shift is observation-quality evidence, not a correction factor.
